newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak blue chips mixed, SAX index eases 1.52 pts.
newsitem.headline: Slovak blue chips mixed, SAX index eases 1.52 pts.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mixed in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday, as the SAX index slightly eased 1.52 points to 202.99.
Penicillin maker Biotika led trading on the bourse's floor, with brokers saying the volume in the issue had been boosted by a block deal.
Biotika closed down five crowns at 955, on a volume of 3,012 traded shares.
"In a fact, only 12 shares were traded in Biotika, the remainder was a block-settlement," Patrik Granec of Slovenska Sporitelna said.
"There was not much fun today, except a few direct trades, made by the National Property Fund... but these stakes were not significant," Granec said.

The state privatisation agency made direct blocks sales of stakes in its portfolio including: - textile firm Ozeta -- 20,079 shares at 1,000 crowns - textile firm Merina -- 18,657 shares at 1,000 crowns - chemical Istrochem -- 128,379 shares at 1,000 crowns.
Steel maker VSZ decreased eight crowns at 640, with only 10 traded shares.
"There is a growth potential in the VSZ issue," Granec said. "I think it was currently only a bit overbidded, after recent good company results announcements."
Commercial bank VUB closed unchanged at 1,770, with 0.4 percent gains to the average price, on 255 traded shares.

Overall volume increased to 542,206 shares, from 315,326 shares traded on Thursday, while turnover climbed up to 306.48 million crowns, from 96.31 million. -- Peter Javurek, Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-563-3687
